LanguageData.TheNetwork_Proc_ChooseItem: Choose an item from the list
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Proc_PremiumTip: Optional. Paid when you accept a quote, on top of the deposit. Better-funded crews take more risks for you and are better prepared. It is not refunded if the job fails.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Proc_NoFixers: No Fixer can broker work right now
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Proc_OpenHint: The Fixer asks around; one to three may bid.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Proc_WantInsurance: I will want insurance if it is offered
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Proc_Preview: At market prices, {0}x {1} would cost about {2} silver. Expect quotes above that: someone has to find them, get them and bring them to you.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Proc_PreviewNone: Choose what you need and how many.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Card_WorseAsk: They want {0} more silver to go on, or they will bring {1} of the {2}.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Card_PartialAsk: They came back with {0} of the {1}.

LanguageData.TheNetwork_Message_Delayed: {0} sends word: {1} will take longer than planned.

LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_UnfilledText:
{0} asked around for {1}, but nobody took the job.

What they heard: {2}.

You can ask again, or open the job to everyone {0} knows.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_HoldText: {0} have {1} ready, but cannot get it to you ({2}). They will keep trying, but they will not hold it forever.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_AwaitingText: {0} have {1} ready for you, but your payment of {2} silver did not come through. They are holding the goods until you pay. If you do not, they will hand over only what you have already paid for.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_PartialText: {0} came back with {1} of {2}. They want to know what you want to do: take what they have, have someone find the rest, or refuse it. If you do not answer, they will send what they have.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_WorseText: {0} report that getting {1} is much harder than anyone thought. They will go on for {2} more silver, or settle for bringing {3}. You can also refuse, and they may walk away. If you do not answer, they will settle for less.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_DeliveredText: Drop pods are coming down with {1}, courtesy of {0}.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_Failed_CatastrophicLos: The job for {1} went badly wrong. {0} lost people and came back with nothing.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_Failed_ContractorLost: {0} never came back from the job for {1}. Nobody expects them now.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_Failed_PreWorkLoss: {0} were gone before they could start on {1}.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_Failed_ContractorWalke: {0} walked away from the job for {1} rather than go on at the old price.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_DepositLost: The deposit is gone: it paid for the attempt.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_Replaced: {0} found someone else to take over the job.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_VoidedText: The job for {0} cannot go ahead: {1}.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_Troubled_Missing: Nobody has heard from {0} since they went after {1}.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_Troubled_Captured: Some of {0} were taken while going after {1}.

LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_NoCargo: As far as anyone knows, they had nothing yet.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_TroubledWait: They may still turn up. If not, the job is lost.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_LeaderKilledText: {0}, who led {1}, was killed on your job.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_LastKnownText: We lost contact with {0} out there. Their last word came from this place.

LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_LastKnownNoCargo: If they found anything, nobody knows what became of it.
LanguageData.TheNetwork_Letter_LastKnownThreat: Whatever stopped them may still be there.
